must_not: Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

user_sees: Title the gym's name (or 'Gym' under the gym's logo for a branded gym), subtitle 'Pay at the desk'
Bell and bag on top
Tabs 'Shop', 'My gym', 'Ranking'; 'Shop' first
must_not: Another gym's name or logo
The bag on a gym with no shop

user_sees: 'My membership', the hours row, 'Check in', 'Message your gym' and the diet plan row once one has come
must_not: The pick jumping back to 'Shop' while the tab stays open

user_sees: The spinner, then the lists refreshed
must_not: A spinner that never stops
Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

note: Three tabs plus bell and bag on one row
